findings.exact_quote: I closed the distance in the space between one toast and the next breath
findings.explanation: Garbled phrase: 'between one toast and the next breath' makes no sense; the idiom is 'between one breath and the next', and there is only one toast.
findings.suggested_replacement: I closed the distance in the space between one breath and the next

findings.exact_quote: that love survived three hundred years of watching him dispense mercy and cruelty
findings.explanation: Percival was turned decades ago after years as a knight. Three hundred years is Aldric's reign, not the time Percival has watched him.
findings.suggested_replacement: that love survived decades of watching him dispense mercy and cruelty

findings.exact_quote: I've had decades of idle centuries to fill
findings.explanation: 'Decades of idle centuries' is self-contradictory and garbled. Percival has lived decades, not centuries.
findings.suggested_replacement: I've had decades of idle time to fill

findings.exact_quote: so easily proven false the moment I tried
findings.explanation: Tense error: the hypothetical should read 'the moment I try', not past tense.
findings.suggested_replacement: so easily proven false the moment I try

findings.exact_quote: you'd need to clear this entire table of suspicion for nobody
findings.explanation: Garbled sentence; 'for nobody' makes no sense. The intended meaning is that no one at the table can be cleared.
findings.suggested_replacement: you'd have to clear no one at this table of suspicion

findings.exact_quote: I have had centuries of nights when the hatred burned hot
findings.explanation: Percival was turned decades ago and says elsewhere he served for decades, not centuries.
findings.suggested_replacement: I have had decades of nights when the hatred burned hot
